name: BlueSoup AI Auto Linker
author: Blue Soup Enterprises

sections.description:
BlueSoup AI Auto Linker is an AI-powered internal linking plugin for WordPress that helps improve SEO by finding smart, contextual internal link opportunities across your content.

Instead of blindly linking keywords everywhere, the plugin uses OpenAI to analyze your pages and posts, understand context, and recommend natural internal links that improve user experience and site structure.

This helps strengthen your internal linking strategy, improve crawlability, surface older content, and support better on-page SEO.

Note: This plugin requires your own OpenAI API key. AI tokens are not included. You pay OpenAI directly for usage. Using the default gpt-4.1-mini model, a typical scan costs a fraction of a cent.

Unlike traditional regex-based auto linker plugins, BlueSoup AI Auto Linker focuses on contextual internal links and smart anchor placement instead of repetitive keyword stuffing.

How it works

  1. Add your OpenAI API key in Settings.
  2. Click Generate AI Suggestions to scan your content.
  3. Review scored, ranked internal link opportunities.
  4. See the exact sentence, proposed anchor text, and suggested destination URL.
  5. Insert the link manually or use Approve and Insert (Pro) for one-click insertion.

Free features

  • AI-powered internal link suggestions
  • Context-aware anchor text recommendations
  • Internal linking opportunities for posts and pages
  • Ranked suggestions with confidence scoring
  • Token usage dashboard
  • Debug and review tools
  • Deep Link mode to revive older content
  • Focus keywords and priority URLs
  • Excluded URLs and orphan page boost
  • Anchor text rotation controls
  • Full settings customization

Pro features (separate download at bluesoup.biz)

  • One-click “Approve and Insert” for automatic internal link insertion
  • SEO Keyword Link Finder — find internal linking opportunities without AI token usage
  • One-click insertion from SEO Keywords results
  • “Find Inbound Links” row action for any post or page
  • Faster workflows for large sites
  • Multi-site license support
  • Priority support

A Pro license is available at bluesoup.biz.

Why use AI for internal linking?

Most internal linking plugins use simple keyword matching rules that create repetitive or unnatural links.

BlueSoup AI Auto Linker analyzes the actual meaning and context of your content to suggest smarter internal links that fit naturally within sentences and improve overall SEO structure.

The plugin also helps avoid over-linking by limiting duplicate destinations and excessive anchor repetition.

SEO benefits

  • Improve internal linking structure
  • Surface older and under-linked pages
  • Strengthen topical relevance
  • Improve anchor text diversity
  • Create contextual internal links naturally
  • Support better WordPress SEO practices
  • Help search engines understand content relationships
  • Reduce orphan pages

Requirements

  • An OpenAI API key
  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+

External Services

This plugin connects to external services:

OpenAI API (api.openai.com)

Used to generate AI-powered internal link suggestions. Your page content and a list of your other pages are sent to OpenAI when you click “Generate AI Suggestions.” This only happens when you explicitly trigger a scan. You must provide your own OpenAI API key.

  • OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy
  • OpenAI Terms of Use: https://openai.com/terms

BlueSoup Promotional Content (bluesoup.biz/plugin-promos.json)

Used to display information about other BlueSoup plugins on the admin page. A small JSON file is fetched via a GET request and cached for 7 days. No data is sent. This request only occurs within the WordPress admin dashboard and never on the public front end.

  • BlueSoup Privacy Policy: https://bluesoup.biz/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bluesoup-ai-auto-linker folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open BlueSoup AI Auto Linker from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key in the Settings tab.
  5. Click Generate AI Suggestions to begin scanning your content for internal link opportunities.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes. You must provide your own OpenAI API key. The plugin uses gpt-4.1-mini by default, which is very inexpensive for most sites.

How much does it cost to run?

Most scans cost fractions of a cent depending on the amount of content analyzed. Daily token limits can be configured to control costs.

Does this automatically insert links?

The free version focuses on reviewing and approving suggestions. The Pro version includes one-click insertion tools.

Will it create spammy links?

No. The plugin limits duplicate destinations, avoids generic anchor text, and focuses on contextual relevance instead of mass keyword linking.

What is the SEO Keywords tab?

The SEO Keywords feature scans your existing content for keyword-based internal linking opportunities without using AI tokens. This feature is included in Pro.

What is Deep Link mode?

Deep Link mode prioritizes older or under-linked content so you can strengthen weaker pages and improve overall site structure.

Can I use this with custom post types?

Currently the plugin supports posts and pages. Additional content type support is planned.

Where is my data stored?

Settings and suggestions are stored in your WordPress database. Content is only sent to OpenAI during scans that you manually initiate.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your settings and saved suggestions remain in your database unless manually removed.
sections.changelog:
5.1.3

  • Fixed: Keyword Link Finder no longer shows insert buttons for pages where the keyword cannot be auto-inserted (keyword only in heading, existing link, or part of a longer word like “movies”)
  • Fixed: Insert failure now shows the specific reason — keyword not in content body, keyword only in compound word, or keyword inside a protected element

5.1.2

  • Moved Keyword Link Finder to the base plugin — available in all builds, no Pro license required
  • Fixed: Keyword Link Finder tab and insert buttons are now visible to all users
  • Fixed: Plugin icon now appears in the WordPress Updates screen

5.1.1

  • Fixed: One-click link insertion now properly reports save failures instead of silently appearing to succeed
  • Fixed: Prompt update banner no longer re-appears on every version bump — only shown when the default AI prompt content actually changes
  • Improved: Edit and View buttons on suggestions are now inline with the page title
  • Fixed: “Already linked to” label corrected to “Already links to”

5.0.1

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0

5.0.0

  • Renamed to BlueSoup AI Auto Linker (slug: bluesoup-ai-auto-linker)
  • Added improved AI-powered contextual internal linking workflows
  • Pro version available separately at bluesoup.biz
  • Added SEO Keyword Link Finder and Find Inbound Links tools
  • Migrated scripts using wp_add_inline_script via admin_enqueue_scripts
  • Updated naming conventions to bsaal_ prefix

4.0.0

  • Initial public release as AI Auto Link Manager
